suites.name: lint
suites.note: package.json script is next lint. Next 16 has no lint command, so the CLI treats lint as a project directory (/workspace/lint) and exits 1. Pre-existing on develop.

suites.name: eslint
suites.note: Direct ESLint run, not used by CI. ESLint 9.39.2 crashes while loading eslint.config.mjs (FlatCompat circular JSON in config validation) before any file is linted. No per-rule results exist.

suites.name: typecheck
suites.note: No typecheck script. tsconfig noEmit is already true.

suites.name: build-lib
suites.note: Library build used by CI before publish.

suites.name: site-build
suites.note: Next.js docs site. Not run in CI. Required to emit Tailwind CSS for visual snapshots.

suites.name: unit
suites.note: No test script and no *.test.* or *.spec.* files.

suites.name: storybook
suites.note: No Storybook, no stories, no test-runner.

suites.name: publish-dry-run
suites.note: Same command CI uses before npm publish.
